Name: Harsh Wilds
Author: Jared
Description: Optional threats for a harder forest, each behind its own config switch, plus more of the forest's old powers: spirits to call, rites, brews, rare beasts and realms beyond the forest. Requires CSFFModFramework 2.28.0 or later. Creatures: a night-roaming lynx (it can also be caught in a baited log trap), a wisent and, in winter, three musk oxen, all of which leave carcasses to butcher, and a river bandit who robs you of travel food if you lose to him. Rare beasts: a white wisent, a lake beast, a frost demon and a lindwurm. Raids: an eagle, a black bear, a wolverine and, with Water-Driven Infrastructure, a heron, each carrying off one card. Hazards: a summer adder, burns for unskilled smiths, insect bites when foraging thickets and, with Forest Lore, an erupting mud volcano. Eight world events: drought, insect plague, crop blight, blood moon, eclipse, aurora, cold snap and algae bloom. Four afflictions: fleas and lice, tooth decay, spirit sickness and the dancing plague, each with a cure made from base-game items (with Herbs and Fungi, its herbs make a stronger dose). Spirit path, with no switch: the Lynx, Goat, Blood and Dragon Spirits, called through the base game's spirit system, and an Ancestor Spirit that lives in a stone cairn you build. Also a mistletoe rite, an athame for letting blood and calling rain, casting bones that read whether the eagle or black bear can come, Beast, Earth and Muscle brews, witchfire, a spirit jar, mask, charms, beast coats and a beast totem, and a Bug Trap for insect plagues. Fair folk: a banshee, a nixie, the Wild Hunt and, with Far Territory, a selkie, all kept at bay for a few days by a Threshold Stone offering (longer for a Fairy Stone). A fairy ring found by foraging leads, on a full-moon night, to the Faerie Realm, home of the fairy king and queen, who each offer one bargain a run. A Moon Basin built beside a Moon Stone leads to the Moon Realm, and a Stone Cairn leads to the Underworld. Each realm has a timed stay, always sends you home, keeps raids and Harsh Wilds animals away, and has one danger with its own switch. A wandering shaman visits the Green Glade once a season to trade spirit reagents and charms. Rewards (meat, affinity, coats, rites) were tuned to their base-game equivalents in 0.11.6; the threats' chances, numbers and lengths are still first guesses not yet balanced against play.
